messages:
alice-support: FYI, we just got a sev2 from AcmeCorp — function calling responses started returning schema validation errors after the 1.12.3 runtime rollout. Golden prompt regressions in their eval set. /inc INC-4231 :fire_engine:
ben-eng: Can you paste the failing request + response? Is this tool selection or schema mismatch? :eyes:
alice-support: Short repro from customer (redacted):
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \n  -H 'Authorization: Bearer REDACTED' \n  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \n  -d '{"model":"gptx-fn-1","input":"calculate tax for $100","tools":[{"name":"calculator","schema":{"type":"object","required":["amount"]}}]}'
```
Response snippet:
```json
{
  "toolCalled": "search",
  "toolOutput": {"results": []},
  "error": "schema validation failed: missing required property: amount"
}
```
alice-support: Customer says it used to call 'calculator' and return {"amount":100, "tax":8}. Now picks search fallback. Happens intermittently, ~4/100 calls. Started right after 1.12.3 rollout at ~1775500000.
carmen-ml: This reads like the function-routing scoring changed or a bug in schema compatibility check. Our golden prompts in eval harness also started failing in nightly run at 1775520000. I have the failing diff.
ci-bot: CI job "fncall-smoke" failed on commit ee1a2c5 (pipeline 3421). Logs: https://ci.redwood.ai/3421 — error: "schema mismatch during tool selection".
eve-qe: Link to failing golden prompt set: https://internal.redwood/evals/golden/fncall/2026-03-16 — 12/200 prompts now pick wrong tool. Attaching minimal test:
```json
{"prompt":"What is the sum of 2 and 3?","expected_tool":"calculator","tool_schema":{"type":"object","required":["a","b"]}}
```
ben-eng: Possible culprits: 1) kernel change that altered tokenization -> function name signal, 2) scoring weights for tool routing adjusted, 3) schema validator stricter about required property names. Which commit in 1.12.3 touches routing?
dave-sre: Rollout window shows gradual deploy across regions; can confirm 1.12.3 was behind a feature flag 'fn-routing-v2' toggled on at 1775498000 for prod. We can toggle off if needed. Latency spike observed in eu-west around the same time but not directly correlated.
alice-support: Customer impact: some flows return search results instead of computed numbers; billing isn't affected but UX broken. They've asked for a rollback or hotfix.
ben-eng: I can cherry-pick a revert of fn-routing-v2 and run smoke tests. Before rollback, we should add a targeted unit/regression test to CI that asserts golden prompts still call the expected tool.
carmen-ml: I agree. We should add schema-aware prompts to the golden suite — include negative cases where extra properties must be ignored and positive cases for minimal required fields. I'll open a PR with tests and sample payloads.
eve-qe: Repro script I ran locally:
```bash
python tests/repro_fncall.py --prompt "calculate tax for $100" --model gptx-fn-1 --repeat 100
# Observed ~6 calls to fallback search, 94 correct calculator calls
```
ben-eng: Thanks, Eve. Adding a deterministic seed to the eval run to reduce flakiness and capturing token-level traces will help root cause.
ci-bot: Triggered pipeline 3422: fncall-smoke + golden-evals (includes new trace logging).
dave-sre: If we do rollback, I'll coordinate a canary rollback to dedicated clusters to verify no other regressions. ETA 30m after PR merge.
alice-support: Customer asked for status update asap. I'll tell them we're triaging, have a rollback option, and working a test/patch.
ben-eng: Plan: (1) revert fn-routing-v2 flag -> rollback canary, (2) add schema-focused golden tests to CI, (3) instrument traces for tool scoring, (4) postmortem + fix for routing scoring. Will open PRs now.
carmen-ml: Also want a short-term mitigation in the model config: prefer exact tool-name match with higher weight when schema is provided. That can be a 1-line config tweak while we fix the scoring algorithm.
eve-qe: I'll add 3 failing examples to the flaky list so CI will block merges until green.
alice-support: Thanks team. I'll update AcmeCorp and create an internal incident card. INC-4231 -> assigned to ben-eng.
ben-eng: PRs: revert flag -> https://git.redwood/pr/551, golden tests -> https://git.redwood/pr/552, routing logs -> https://git.redwood/pr/553. Will monitor CI.
ci-bot: Pipeline 3422 finished: fncall-smoke failed (golden-evals 2/200 show mismatch). Attaching failing prompt ids: [14, 87].
carmen-ml: Prompt 87: minimal payload used property name 'amount' but schema expected 'a' — looks like schema normalization changed. That explains intermittent failures when customers use different naming conventions.
dave-sre: Rollback started on canary cluster at 1775556800. Monitoring error rate and latency.
alice-support: Customer updated: they'd prefer a hotfix rather than full rollback if it preserves other improvements. They're ok with brief maintenance window.
ben-eng: I'm going to roll the config tweak (prefer exact tool-name match if schema present) to canary first. If green, will promote.
ci-bot: Deploy 1.12.4-canary started (artifact ee1a2c5 + config tweak).
eve-qe: Running repro script against canary now — 100/100 correct calculator calls. Marking as successful locally.
ci-bot: Deploy succeeded on canary. Monitoring metrics: tool-routing fallback rate -> 0.1% (pre-fix ~6%).
dave-sre: Canary looks healthy. Proceeding with phased rollout.
ben-eng: After we stabilize, we'll merge golden tests and require them in PR gating. Also adding a labeled test matrix for schema name variants.
alice-support: I'll update AcmeCorp: config tweak deployed to canary and being rolled out, ETA full rollout 45m. Appreciate the quick response. :thumbsup:
ben-eng: After rollout, follow-up tasks: long-term fix to scoring, postmortem, and add telemetry that logs chosen tool + schema hash for faster triage.
carmen-ml: I'll own the postmortem write-up and coordinate with product on communication.
alice-support: Closing the escalation thread for now, will reopen if customer reports further failures. Thanks everyone.
